---
title: "Supplementary Methods and Figures"
# Section numbers (S1, S1.1, …) come from the filter, which prefixes heading
# text directly so HTML and docx carry identical S-numbers; pandoc's own
# numbering stays off to avoid double-numbering.
number-sections: false
filters:
  - scripts/supplement_numbering.lua
# Float titles are spelled out ("Supplementary Figure 1") because Quarto's
# caption composition puts a non-breaking space between title and number,
# which renders a bare "Figure S" title as "Figure S 1".
crossref:
  fig-title: "Supplementary Figure"
  tbl-title: "Supplementary Table"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
from results_loader import Results
r = Results(Path("results/_latest"))
```

# Cohort and ingestion diagnostics {#sec-suppl-cohort}

## Per-participant rib-side count distribution {#sec-suppl-rib-yield}

```{python}
#| label: tbl-suppl-rib-count
#| tbl-cap: "Distribution of per-participant rib-side counts among the candidate cohort. The inclusion criterion ([Methods §2.5](manuscript.qmd#cohort-definition-and-quality-control)) requires exactly 24 rib sides; participants with different counts are excluded. Low counts (≤ 23) are consistent with transitional thoracolumbar vertebrae, missing segmentations or merged segmentations; high counts (≥ 25) with supernumerary cervical or lumbar ribs."
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print(r.rib_count_distribution_md())
```

```
:::

::: {.content-visible unless-format="html"}

```
:::

**Adjusted (multivariable) OLS effect maps.** **(A)** Standardised β and **(B)** Frisch–Waugh–Lovell partial R² per (shape descriptor × predictor) pair from the single adjusted model ([Methods §2.8.2](manuscript.qmd#sec-adjusted-analyses)) – the mutually-adjusted counterpart to the [main-text targeted maps](manuscript.qmd#fig-targeted). FDR-masked at q ≥ 0.05; cluster-robust standard errors at the participant level.

:::
